writeup.key_factor: The playoff-compressed model makes Milwaukee a 50.9% favorite (fair -104) at home: compressed Brewers 1574 + 12 home field, with Logan Henderson (#2 tier, 11-3, 2.47 ERA) facing ace Yoshinobu Yamamoto (+45). BetOnline.ag offers +121, and Milwaukee already leads the NLCS 1-0.
writeup.risk: The edge is tier-sensitive: if Henderson is rated as a league-average starter instead of a #2, Milwaukee drops to 48.1% and the edge falls below 3%. Yamamoto is a true ace and the Dodgers, down 0-1, are desperate.

writeup.key_factor: The model makes Buffalo a 48.1% shot (fair +108) on the road — Bills 1511 vs Rams 1469 + 55 home field — but LowVig.ag offers +149. Josh Allen and Matthew Stafford are both healthy, and SoFi Stadium's fixed roof takes weather out of the equation.
writeup.risk: Buffalo is banged up: DT Ed Oliver and WR Josh Palmer are out and WR D.J. Moore is questionable, leaving a patched-up receiving corps against Stafford, Nacua and Adams. This underdog loses more often than it wins — the value is in the price, not the probability.
